posts.title: AI agent evaluation needs more than pass@1
posts.text: AI agent evaluation needs more than pass@1. We ran 400 long-horizon tasks and found that success on the final step hides partial-credit failures in the middle of the trajectory. Rubric-based scoring caught 3x more constraint violations than outcome-only checks. #AIAgents #AgentEvaluation #LLM #AI

posts.text: RLVR in practice: verifiable rewards removed most of the reward hacking we saw with a learned reward model on maths and code tasks. The open question is how to extend it to tasks without a checker. #RLVR #ReinforcementLearning #PostTraining

posts.text: Three lessons from a quarter of LLM post-training: preference data quality beats quantity, evaluation harnesses must be versioned with the model, and RLHF regressions show up first in long-context tasks. #PostTraining #RLHF #ModelEvaluation

posts.title: RL environments are the new bottleneck for AI agents
posts.text: Reinforcement learning environments are becoming the bottleneck for training AI agents. Stateful, verifiable environments with tool use let us measure long-horizon behaviour instead of single-turn answers. We compared three environment designs on the same reward model. #RLEnvironments #AIAgents #ReinforcementLearning
